components.note: Attendance and active participation expected, but no formal credit
Weekly Canvas discussion, 12 of 14 weeks; 10 points a week (5 post, 5 reply)
10 of the first 12 weeks; each entry scored 0-10 on a rubric

grading.drop: Two of the 14 weekly discussions can be missed without penalty; only 10 journal entries count (the 11th and 12th earn nothing).
grading.extraCredit: No extra credit for discussion participation beyond the requirement.

materials.item: Coates, Between the World and Me (2015)
Required films (titles not in excerpt; more may be added)

AFRO 312.attendance: Students are expected to attend and actively participate in class, but participation carries no formal credit.
AFRO 312.lateWork: Discussion posts close Sunday 11:59pm each week. Canvas accepts no late journal entries, and emailed entries are not accepted.
AFRO 312.makeups: No make-up for missed discussions except emergencies needing long absences excused by the student dean's office.
other: Journal entries are graded on writing and fit with the assignment's spirit, not on content
Weekly discussion posts and replies must be substantive; short agreement comments do not count
